author: PSV
body:
https://imgur.com/gallery/suF9U

These screenshots show Rilo kicking people from the server when they wouldn’t leave the red team during a scrim. This qualifies as abuse because we invited both Praetorians and Xenarch and we were in the midst of deciding who to scrim (us being Jalapeños) so it is unjust for Rilo to use his perms to kick someone because he didn’t get his way yet.
